dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Some of the greatest heroes come from the humblest of origins. I think that the same goes for good food too.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: There's an intimacy and charm to humble roadside stalls that no fancy restaurant could hope to replicate. Plus, you get to try food from a bunch of different chefs in the same place.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: The question is... Which place shall we start with? Any recommendations?
